title: Criteria workflow interface declaration (KB-310, ADR 307)
description:
Machine-readable interface contract a shared workflow tree declares about what it requires and what it may be overridden with. One 'interface.json' per tree root. The criteria-k8s operator validates a run's workflow binding against this declaration BEFORE job creation (fail closed): a required adapter kind missing from the binding's adapterImages, a mount or secret-env lane the binding does not resolve, or an undeclared config key the binding carries is rejected at admission with both sides (tree + project) named.

The declaration is the tree's supported reuse surface: a project binding may override only config keys the tree declares as slots ('no adding hacks to do overrides if the workflow already supports it'). Slots that name a platform-delivered ConfigMap key (buildCmd, testCmd, ciGateCmd, baseBranch — the KB-103 render) are delivered through the existing per-run config rendering; a slot naming its own key rides the same pipeline as a rendered slot.

Config-library note: the example payload inline in k8s/examples/routes-configmap.yaml carries an identical copy per workflowLibrary entry (byte-for-byte); scripts/interface_validate.mjs cross-checks the copies and rejects drift.

workflow.description: Workflow tree name the declaration belongs to. Must equal the tree directory name the file lives in (scripts/interface_validate.mjs enforces the pairing).

description.description: Human summary of the derivation (which surfaces the tree consumes and how the sets were derived). Never parsed by the operator.

adapters.description: Adapter kinds the composed run requires (the tree plus its locked subworkflow closure). A binding whose adapterImages lacks a kind listed here is rejected at admission with the named gap. Optional; empty = the tree requires no adapter image from the binding (engine-internal adapters, e.g. decision_kind).

mounts.description: Storage mount paths the composed run requires: name, mountPath and the storage kind the binding must supply at that path (scope KB-310: pvc or tmp). A binding volume at an undeclared mountPath/kind is rejected as unknown-slot; a required mount path missing is rejected with the named gap. Path normalization is byte-exact.

name.description: Binding volume name (matches routes.json workflow volumes[].name).

mountPath.description: Container mount path the binding must supply, e.g. /data. Byte-exact; no trailing-slash normalization.

kind.description: Storage kind the binding must carry at that path.

secretEnv.description: Secret env names the composed run must resolve from the binding's secret lanes (binding Secrets[].env keys). Each must be present in at least one binding secret env map at admission (rejection names the missing lane); a binding secret env key NOT declared here is rejected as unknown-slot (fail closed). Entries whose env map is empty declare a lane mount with no env surface (e.g. netrc fetch plumbing) and are exempt from the unknown-slot check.

env.description: Non-secret run-level env names (binding workflow env map) the tree requires. Optional; empty = the tree requires no run-level env. A binding workflow env name not listed here is rejected as unknown-slot. Volume-level env maps (CRITERIA_* engine plumbing) are platform-owned and never validated against this list.

configSlots.description: Config the tree honors from the project's per-repo ConfigMap (the binding's config surface). Each entry: the ConfigMap data key ('slot'), the tree workflow variable the value lands in ('variable'), and the step/agent that reads it ('target'). The tree — not the platform — decides the override surface: a pinned ConfigMap key outside the platform core set (buildCmd, testCmd, ciGateCmd, baseBranch) and this list is rejected at admission as unknown-slot. Platform-core keys NOT declared here are likewise rejected for this tree (the tree does not honor them). Slot variables are cross-checked against the tree's declared variables by scripts/interface_validate.mjs.

slot.description: Per-repo ConfigMap data key the binding carries this slot's value under. Must be one of the platform-delivered keys (buildCmd, testCmd, ciGateCmd, baseBranch): those are the only config values a project binding can carry through the KB-103 render.

variable.description: Tree workflow variable the value is delivered to (must be declared by the tree; buildCmd/build_cmd, testCmd/test_cmd, ciGateCmd/ci_gate_cmd, baseBranch/base_branch).

target.description: Step/agent the slot lands in (documentation for troubleshootability, e.g. 'kanboard_develop_v1 developer CI gate').

description.description: Optional human note on what a project may put in this slot.
